meta.label: CDE Connection
meta.description: Parameters for a Cloudera Data Engineering (CDE) Spark Connect connection

params.name: host
params.label: Virtual Cluster Endpoint
params.description: CDE Virtual Cluster endpoint URL — the vcluster-endpoint value from ~/.cde/config.yaml. Example: https://2z2zdm7l.cde-ggkw9sgd.csa-lab.a465-9q4k.cloudera.site/dex/api/v1

params.name: cdpEndpoint
params.label: CDP Control Plane URL
params.description: CDP control plane URL — the cdp-endpoint value from ~/.cde/config.yaml

params.name: sessionName
params.label: Session Name
params.description: CDE Spark Connect session name. Defaults to dss-<connectionName> if left blank.

params.name: db
params.label: Default Database
params.description: Default database/schema to use after connecting

params.name: defaultCatalog
params.label: Default Catalog
params.description: Default catalog to use after connecting
